title: A green full-suite capture from solo_execute is not reused by regression-sentinel, which re-runs the suite under --phase regression
detail: red-on-fork-point (2026-11-20): solo_execute capture on 2df7dfd (4527 passed) was recorded under phase solo_execute; regression-sentinel re-ran the identical suite on the same commit under --phase regression because the reviewing gate reads regression-phase evidence (~4m38s, a second full run). Evidence for the same tree hash should credit across phases, or the solo-lane capture hint should name --phase regression.
